app.title: Mini Highlight Advisor
app.intro_caption: Upload a photo of a primed miniature (background-removed PNG is fastest). You'll get a painted preview + a paint-by-layer plan. Best with a raking side light (not on-axis flash) — that gives the sculpt the shadows the tool reads.
app.input_help: Photo = primed mini under a raking light (luminance). PS = import a recovered normal map for dark/primed minis; drag a virtual light.
app.upload_prompt: Upload a photo of a primed miniature to begin, or load a saved project above.
app.error_processing: Error processing image — see traceback below.

angles.heading: **Angles**
angles.added_msg: '{label}' added — it's now the active angle for editing.

colour.scheme_caption: Tag each region, then pick a hero colour and a mood.
colour.harmony_help: Cycle this to re-roll the free regions' colours.
colour.generated_success: Scheme generated and applied. Adjust any colour below.
colour.insert_first_help: Insert new darkest band at top
colour.save_recipe_caption: Save current bands as a recipe (name it, then Save)
colour.scheme_applied_info: {count} region(s) updated — no saved colour for: {skipped}

coverage.metal_steps_heading: **Metal steps** (value bands for this NMM region)
coverage.metal_steps_help: How many brightness bands the reflected environment is cut into. NMM has no per-band coverage — each step owns a fixed value range.
coverage.coverage_heading: **Coverage** (% of the model each layer occupies)

gallery.no_angles_info: Add angles in the 🖌️ Miniature tab to see them together here.
gallery.caption: Same paints, every face. Switch to the 🖌️ Studio tab to edit the active angle.
gallery.active_caption: ✓ Active — go to the 🖌️ Studio tab to edit.
gallery.inactive_caption: Go to 🖌️ Studio to activate this angle.

osl.heading: **Object-source glow** (OSL) — click where the light lives, pick a colour.
osl.click_caption: Click the source point on the mini below.
osl.no_source_info: No source placed yet — click on the mini.

paints.heading: **My paints** (Vallejo)
paints.no_paints_caption: No paints selected yet — tick the paints you own above.
paints.catalogue_caption: Catalogue: {count} paints (Vallejo Model Color + Game Color)

ps.info: Import a photometric-stereo bundle produced by `tools/ps_tool.py`: a normal map and its mask. See docs/ps-capture-guide.md.
ps.dimension_error: Dimension mismatch: normal {shape1} vs mask {shape2}. The two files must be the same size.
ps.normal_map_error: That doesn't look like a normal map (values don't decode to unit normals over the mask). Re-export the bundle from ps_tool.
ps.albedo_warning: albedo.png didn't pass the plausibility check — falling back to grey display base.

regions.draw_caption: Trace a lasso around an area below, then click **Add region**.
regions.new_region_heading: **New region** — lasso on the image above.
regions.no_lasso_warning: Trace a lasso around an area on the image first.
regions.lasso_no_overlap_warning: Lasso didn't overlap the mini — trace around a part of the model.

relight.heading: **Virtual light** — drag to move where the highlights fall.

results.edge_sens_help: Few sharpest edges (left) to more edges (right).
results.recess_help: Darken concave recesses from surface normals (PS mode only).
results.technique_help:
Smooth layering: thin glazes, dark to light.
Drybrush: drag a nearly-dry brush across raised surfaces.
NMM (PS mode only): non-metallic metal from surface normals.
results.horizon_help: Where the sky/ground break sits on the reflection.
results.light_dir_help: Azimuth of the reflected light streak/glint (90=top, 135=upper-left).
results.smoothing_help: Blurs the surface normals before the reflection lookup. Raw PS normals are noisy; 1.5-3 gives coherent metal zones. 0 = off (raw, speckly).
results.relief_cap_help: Cap band count to what the relief supports.
results.coloured_mini_help: Normalize brightness per region so each painted colour reads its own relief. Off = primed-mini mode (default).
results.osl_steps_caption: Paint the object normally first, then glaze the glow on top.
results.no_result_info: Set your colours in Studio first, then come here to paint.
results.steps_caption: Work dark to light within each region.
results.too_dark_warning: "{name}" is too dark / low-contrast to read relief - showing 1 band. Try a paler basecoat here, or a stronger raking side light.
results.flat_warning: "{name}" looks fairly flat - showing {n} band(s) instead of {requested}. Untick "Auto-reduce bands on flat regions" to force all {requested}.
